subject: Strategic market sprint — OKR pulse: competitor pricing & model releases
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.com>, Sales Leadership <sales-leads@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategic market sprint — OKR pulse: competitor pricing & model releases

Team,

Quick pulse ahead of Monday’s QBR prep — two high-signal developments we should bake into the OKR sprint and the competitor-facing playbook:

1) ModelHub (public) — ModelX v2 launch: lower list price, same latency claims
   - Release note: ModelX v2 claims 20% token-cost reduction at 2048 seq vs their v1.
   - Pricing: new ‘burst’ tier appears to undercut our hosted mid-tier rates on short sequences.
   - Risk: could compress trials with price-sensitive startups; lower price + similar quality will shift POV for self-serve procurement.

2) Acme AI — Managed endpoint rollout + enterprise burst pricing (private announcement, cc’d below)
   - They’re packaging a managed offering with reserved-pool discounts and an aggressive introductory credit for ISVs.
   - Their pitch emphasizes single-API simplicity and a pre-bundled monitoring dashboard.

Recommended immediate asks:
- Ops/Product: validate our effective unit economics vs short sequence workloads (action: Karthik to run cost delta by EOD Fri).
- Sales: update pitch deck to highlight Dedicated and Private economics & our fallback reliability story (Marissa).
- DX/Docs: add two-line comparison to self-serve onboarding materials for short-seq billing differences.
- Leadership: consider a limited-time QBR-facing counter-offer bundle (Marketing + Sales to scope).

Attachments: market_playbook_v2.pdf (summary slides) and a live OKR impact matrix I started (okr_impact_matrix.xlsx). Link in the thread.

I’m forwarding Acme’s product note below — relevant excerpt plus my take.

Best,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Head of Competitive Strategy, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Acme AI Product Team <product@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 16:02:11 -0400
Subject: Announcing Acme Managed: reserved pools + burst credits
To: press@modelhub.ai

Hi all,

We’re excited to launch Acme Managed — enterprise-ready endpoints with reserved pool discounts and a short-burst credit model to smooth migration.

Highlights:
- Reserved pool discounts (up to 35% for 6/12 month commitments)
- Burst credits for onboarding (first 30 days)
- Integrated metrics dashboard + fine-grained key controls

Thanks,
Acme AI Product Team

Thanks, Jonas — helpful snapshot. A few quick items from my side:

- I agree we should prioritize short-seq economics in the next Optimize release notes. If ModelHub is undercutting on the short tail, our caching + prefix-aware batching is a clear differentiator; call that out with numbers where possible.
- I’ll ask Solutions to bring two anonymized customer examples to the QBR that show switching cost beyond pure $/token.
- Can you add a one-paragraph suggested script for AMs to use when they see pilot pricing objections?

I’ll slot this into the leadership packet and add a 1-slide competitive motion.

Laura
